name: George Brown (musician)
description: '''George Brown''' (January 15, 1949 – November 17, 2023), also known by the name '''George "Funky" Brown''', was an American musician who was a founding member of the funk, R&B, and soul band [[Kool & the Gang]]. Born in Jersey City, Brown co-founded the group in the mid-1960s alongside [[Robert “Kool” Bell]].
